mentions.name: SF Tree Reporting (urban tree map app)
mentions.description: This app is an urban tree map that lets users record trees as they walk and merges those recordings into the general city tree data. It uses DuckDB pipelines for processing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I finished wiring up the backend data merge so user(s) (aka me, really) can record trees as they walk and have those merged into the general city data on my urban tree map app[1].

mentions.name: Urban Tree Visualization
mentions.description: An interactive urban tree visualization spanning multiple cities, with a polished ingest pipeline for adding new cities, genus/species-level views that aggregate across cities, and imagery to identify species. Planned features include an end-user facing ingest pipeline for adding trees observed on walks and a performance pass to handle growing data volume.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on my urban tree visualization! Spent some time polishing the ingest pipeline to make it easier to add new cities, added a genus/species level view to aggregate across cities, and added in some basic imagery so I can see what species are.
